lifecycle.creation_reason: Created to be the TRUTHFUL NON-PASS OWNER of MT-108 residual item (8), PT-102-B. MT-108 V4 remediation item 6 requires a re-deferred residual to name an owner that REMAINS NON-PASS, and item 7 of the same plan states that a BLOCKED/DEFERRED marker may not close a required pixel row. MT-102 is PASS_V1, so deferring to it would have closed a required pixel row against a passing owner.

scope.summary: Capture the real-GPU worksurface screenshot on a live Handshake window and visually inspect it, closing PT-102-B with pixels rather than a typed deferral.

defect_detail.why_no_cargo_test_can_reach_it: Verified at HEAD 8a77e315. HandshakeApp::capture_worksurface_screenshot_to (src/frontend/handshake_native/src/app.rs:12991-13037) delegates to crate::mcp::screenshot::capture_handshake_window(), which is a Win32 PrintWindow capture of a LIVE application window. No cargo test process owns such a window, so no test invocation can produce a real frame.
defect_detail.why_the_existing_test_does_not_prove_it: tests/test_visual_debugger.rs:131-141 accepts EITHER a Deferred OR a Captured outcome. That is correct for a headless CI host but it means the test can never evidence a capture, so a green run says nothing about PT-102-B.
defect_detail.distinct_from_the_wgpu_readback_path: MT-108 current_head_findings finding_2 proves this host CAN materially capture GPU frames with HANDSHAKE_GPU_SCREENSHOT=1 (test_loom_address went 16 passed / 0 failed, EXIT 0, and canvas_loom_chip_screenshot produced real pixels). That is the egui_kittest wgpu READBACK path. PT-102-B is the PrintWindow-on-a-live-window path. The two are different mechanisms and the former does NOT discharge the latter - recorded explicitly so a future implementer does not close this item with the wrong evidence.
defect_detail.host_capability: The host is proven GPU-capable, so this is a live-run and inspection task, not a hardware blocker.

acceptance_criteria: AC-126-1: a real worksurface screenshot is captured from a live Handshake window on a real-GPU host, and the resulting image is OPENED and DESCRIBED - not merely produced. Record the artifact path and its sha256.

AC-126-2: the capture must NOT foreground the app, steal focus, hijack keyboard input, or move the OS cursor, per HBR-QUIET and CX-503D1. PrintWindow on a non-foreground window is the sanctioned mechanism; state how quiet operation was verified.

AC-126-3: the inspection describes what is actually visible - readable controls, no overlap or clipping, correct active/error/disabled states - rather than asserting the file is non-empty. A non-zero byte count is not visual proof.
AC-126-4: the headless path still emits its typed DEFERRED marker and still passes on a host without a window, so CI is not broken by this MT.

AC-126-5: record whether any automated assertion is possible at all on this path. If it genuinely cannot be automated, say so as a typed statement so the next capstone does not re-litigate it from scratch.
proof_targets: PT-126-1: the captured artifact path, its sha256, and a written description of the inspected frame.
PT-126-2: evidence of quiet operation - no foregrounding, no focus or Z-order change during capture.
PT-126-3: the headless deferred-marker path re-run and still green.
scope.risk_if_missed: MT-108 AC-108-1 cannot honestly close: a required pixel row would be closed by a typed deferral against a PASS_V1 owner, which the V4 verdict explicitly forbids.

gui_obligation.requirement: A real captured frame, opened and described. This MT exists precisely because a marker is not a picture.

user_manual_obligation.requirement: Document how an operator or model captures a worksurface screenshot, and what the typed DEFERRED marker means when no GPU window is available.

hbr_obligations.VIS: HBR-VIS: a required pixel row may not be closed by a typed DEFERRED. This MT is the row.
hbr_obligations.QUIET: HBR-QUIET-001: capture must not change foreground window or Z-order.
hbr_obligations.INT: HBR-INT-009: Flight Recorder NOT_APPLICABLE for the capture itself; internal_diagnostics and Palmistry DEFERRED-with-reason while unshipped per CX-981-005.
